ci_support_linux_64_r_base4.4.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cran_mirror:
- https://cloud.r-project.org
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  r-base:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
r_base:
- '4.4'

about.description:
Stratigraphic ranges of fossil marine animal genera from
Sepkoski's (2002) published compendium. No changes have been
made to any taxonomic names. However, first and last appearance
intervals have been updated to be consistent with stages of the
International Geological Timescale. Functionality for
generating a plot of Sepkoski's evolutionary fauna is also
included. For specific details on the compendium see: Sepkoski,
J. J. (2002). A compendium of fossil marine animal genera.
Bulletins of American Paleontology, 363, pp. 1–560 (ISBN
0-87710-450-6). Access:
<https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/item/40634#page/5/mode/1up>.
about.summary: Sepkoski's Fossil Marine Animal Genera Compendium

name: r-sepkoski
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.0.1"

package:
  name: r-sepkoski
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
- url:
  - ${{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/sepkoski_${{ version }}.tar.gz
  - ${{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/sepkoski/sepkoski_${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5a502e39f298296d3d9efca2601b7a7922ae579974ee324000a5d5f3178da1cb

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic
  script: ${{ R }} CMD INSTALL --build .

requirements:
  host:
    - r-base
  run:
    - r-base

tests:
  - r:
      libraries:
        - sepkoski
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - r-testthat
    script:
      - Rscript -e "testthat::test_file('tests/testthat.R', stop_on_failure=TRUE)"

about:
  homepage: https://sepkoski.palaeoverse.org/
  summary: Sepkoski's Fossil Marine Animal Genera Compendium
  description: |-
    Stratigraphic ranges of fossil marine animal genera from
    Sepkoski's (2002) published compendium. No changes have been
    made to any taxonomic names. However, first and last appearance
    intervals have been updated to be consistent with stages of the
    International Geological Timescale. Functionality for
    generating a plot of Sepkoski's evolutionary fauna is also
    included. For specific details on the compendium see: Sepkoski,
    J. J. (2002). A compendium of fossil marine animal genera.
    Bulletins of American Paleontology, 363, pp. 1–560 (ISBN
    0-87710-450-6). Access:
    <https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/item/40634#page/5/mode/1up>.
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - ${{ PREFIX }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3
  repository: https://github.com/palaeoverse/sepkoski
  documentation: https://sepkoski.palaeoverse.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - LewisAJones
